slide_1.first_textbox: Operational risks increase when systems scale across teams and regions.
slide_1.first_bullet: Data drift can quietly reduce model quality over time if retraining triggers are not clearly defined and continuously monitored.
slide_1.second_bullet: Ambiguous ownership between product, platform, and operations teams can delay incident response when failures happen under peak traffic.
slide_1.third_bullet: Unclear model documentation makes it hard for reviewers to understand assumptions, limitations, and expected behavior in edge cases.
slide_1.second_textbox: Documented safeguards make governance practical rather than symbolic.
